meta.promptText: Which serum should I buy for acne-prone skin in India under ₹700?

response.text:
For **acne-prone skin in India under ₹700**, the safest general pick is a **niacinamide serum** with a lightweight formula, and the strongest budget option in the results is **Foxtale 12% Niacinamide Clarifying Serum** at **₹219**.[1]

If your acne is mainly **active breakouts and clogged pores**, a **salicylic acid serum** is usually the better ingredient choice; if your concern is **oil control, post-acne marks, and larger pores**, **niacinamide** is the better fit.[4][13][19]

Good options from the results under ₹700 are:

- **Foxtale 12% Niacinamide Clarifying Serum** — best budget value, ₹219, highest niacinamide concentration in the ranking, and positioned for post-acne marks and oil control.[1]
- **Dot & Key 10% Niacinamide + Cica Serum** — designed for oily, acne-prone, and sensitive skin; lightweight and quick absorbing.[9][12]
- **Plum 10% Niacinamide Face Serum Rice Water** — listed around ₹500–700 and commonly recommended for hydration plus brightening in oily/acne-prone skin.[14]
- **Plum 2% Encapsulated Salicylic Acid Face Serum** — better if you want an acne-focused serum for active pimples and oil control.[13]
- **The Derma Co 2% Salicylic Acid Serum** — mentioned in the sources as a good choice for oily, acne-prone skin and open pores.[15]

If you want one simple recommendation, buy **Foxtale 12% Niacinamide Clarifying Serum** for **overall acne-prone skin with oil control and marks**.[1] If your main issue is **active acne**, choose a **2% salicylic acid serum** instead.[13][19]

If you want, I can narrow this down to the **best serum for oily acne-prone skin, dry acne-prone skin, or sensitive acne-prone skin** under ₹700.
